sequence: POST auth/refresh returned 200 and changed the access token
Token-prop watcher started a User Modeling load before the retried command completed

observed_failure.visible_effect: The approval reason and decision buttons briefly appeared, then disappeared and the submit button returned.
observed_failure.log_and_code_supported_cause: The store checked only project identity, allowing an earlier read for the same project to overwrite a later owner command.

persistence_check.method: Local PostgreSQL SELECT in a READ ONLY transaction; credentials used only in memory.
persistence_check.conclusion: The submitted gate was persisted correctly; the defect was stale frontend state.

fix.behavior: Monotonic readSequence guards prevent reads overtaken by commands or newer refreshes from replacing snapshot, gate or readiness state.
